If the hospital already charged ₹7,000 for RMO services, then why was an additional ₹2,000 charged as an emergency fee? And if the emergency admission charge of ₹2,000 was already included, then what was the need to charge another ₹7,000 separately for RMO services?

Dr. Prafull is only available in the hospital occasionally. Most of the time, he is unavailable, and the patients are mainly handled by assistant doctors and nurse in charge on duty.
